The '''Tarisian bark beetle''' was a rare [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. During the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] like [[Liefur]] and [[Co'overma]] attempted a project to preserve endangered Taris species, though the bark beetle was out of their scope.<ref name="Making Trouble">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Making Trouble|Taris}}</ref>
